boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Messiah University study environments, from quiet library areas to open atriums and general-use computer labs.

cards.title: Murray Library quiet-study areas
cards.subtitle: Murray Library, Messiah University
cards.notes: Use the library’s quiet-study areas when you need to read or write with fewer interruptions; bring your research questions to library staff during open hours.
cards.short_summary: A library setting for quiet study and research.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah states that Murray Library is available for quiet study and research use.
cards.access_notes: Visitors and alumni are welcome, though current students, faculty, and staff are the library’s primary clientele and policies apply.

cards.title: Murray Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons, Murray Library
cards.notes: Choose a documented group-study room for a shared working session; coordinate your materials and check the library’s current room-use guidance before settling in.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated rooms documented in Messiah’s Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah’s Learning Commons project created two group study rooms in Murray Library.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current availability and any reservation requirements with Murray Library before use.

cards.title: Murray Library Informal Study Area
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons, Murray Library
cards.notes: Set up in the informal study area for flexible independent work; use headphones if your task needs focus and keep pathways clear for other library users.
cards.short_summary: An informal work area within the Library Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah documented development of an informal study area as part of the Murray Library Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current policies and hours before planning a session.

cards.entity_name: Murray Library Public Access Computer Stations
cards.title: Murray Library PAC stations
cards.subtitle: Main lobby, Murray Library
cards.notes: Use a Windows PAC station for online research or coursework when you need a campus computer; save work to your account or a personal storage device.
cards.short_summary: Lobby computers for research and coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Murray Library’s Windows PAC stations are in the main lobby and are available to students, faculty, staff, and guests.
cards.access_notes: Guest access is available; guests and alumni should ask at the Circulation Desk to be logged in, and guest PAC printing is unavailable.

cards.entity_name: Murray Library Quiet Study and Testing Area
cards.title: Murray Library quiet study and testing area
cards.subtitle: First floor near the Office of Academic Accessibility
cards.notes: For a quieter library session, look for the first-floor area beyond the display case near OAA; respect testing activity and keep conversations elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library area used for quiet study and testing.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah identifies a first-floor Murray Library area near OAA where quiet study and testing occur.
cards.access_notes: This area supports quiet study and testing; keep noise low and defer to any posted testing or accessibility guidance.

cards.title: Howe Atrium
cards.subtitle: Boyer Hall, Messiah University
cards.notes: Bring reading or a laptop to the two-story Howe Atrium for daylight and open seating; select this setting when a bright, visible workspace suits your task.
cards.short_summary: A glass atrium designed for open, well-lit study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah describes the Howe Atrium as a two-story glass atrium designed to provide open, well-lit study and leisure space.
cards.source_title: School of Arts, Culture and Society Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located in Boyer Hall; use the space in accordance with building and event access conditions.

cards.title: Frey 166 computer lab
cards.subtitle: Frey Hall, Messiah University
cards.notes: Use Frey 166 when course work requires a campus computer or teacher-station setup; verify it is not reserved for a class before beginning a work block.
cards.short_summary: A general-use computer lab in Frey Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah lists Frey 166 as a general computer lab available to all students and reservable for classes.
cards.access_notes: Available to all students, but general labs can be reserved for classes; confirm the room is open before use.

cards.title: Boyer 337 computer lab
cards.subtitle: Boyer Hall, Messiah University
cards.notes: Head to Boyer 337 for computer-based coursework between classes; check the room schedule first because Messiah makes general labs available for class reservations.
cards.short_summary: A general-use computer lab in Boyer Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah lists Boyer 337 as a general computer lab available to all students and reservable for classes.
cards.access_notes: Available to all students, but general labs can be reserved for classes; confirm the room is open before use.

cards.entity_name: Jordan Science Center and Kline Hall Study Rooms and Lounges
cards.title: Jordan–Kline study rooms and lounges
cards.subtitle: Jordan Science Center and Kline Hall
cards.notes: Use the study rooms and lounges between science classes for reading or project planning; department literature is available in these spaces for subject-focused work.
cards.short_summary: Science-building rooms and lounges with department literature.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah states that Jordan Science Center and Kline Hall study rooms and lounges provide literature and space for students to work between classes.
cards.source_title: School of Science, Engineering and Health Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located in the connected Jordan Science Center and Kline Hall; use building spaces according to current departmental access conditions.

cards.title: Bittner private study rooms
cards.subtitle: Bittner Residence, South Complex
cards.notes: Bittner residents can use their floor’s private study rooms for focused work; bring needed materials and follow residence-hall quiet and guest policies.
cards.short_summary: Resident private study rooms on every Bittner floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah states that each Bittner floor has private study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Bittner is a first-year residence hall; these rooms are within residential space and access is subject to residence-life policies.

warnings: Room availability, building access, and reservation requirements can change; verify current conditions with Messiah University before visiting.
